build: Signed Release Shilling Perf, production Swift sources linked into isolated synthetic fixture
method: Three fresh processes per variant, two pushes/focus/ten-key typing/pops per editor per process. Medians include six samples per phase; samples within one process are not independent.
Push timing ends after a populated title field is found plus 50 ms; it is content readiness, not completion of the navigation animation. Pop uses a fixed one-second observation window.
cpuMs is application CPU time across all threads during the phase, not a CPU utilization percentage or battery measurement.
Display-link callback gaps are supplementary measurements and can miss work before the first callback. The synchronized Instruments trace provides rendering-hitch evidence.

One Animation Hitches + Time Profiler + Points of Interest recording per variant, with eight pushes/pops. Signposts exclude fixture seeding and initial root mounting. Hitches are assigned by start time; context intervals and inclusive CPU stacks overlap.

Native menu selections and keyboard Done actions are invoked using public UIKit controls inside the fixture. This verifies the production bindings and handlers but is not a physical touch or VoiceOver user test.
All recorded thermalState values were nominal (0). No changes to the normal personal app or its database.
changes: Skip identical immutable StateFlow replays in editor FlowModel
Create the Schedule/Transaction keyboard toolbar only while one of their fields is focused
